head: Fubo now includes Disney+ and Hulu with ads on Pro and Elite plans
dek: Fubo is adding the ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu bundle, a 12.99 dollar a month value, to its Pro and Elite plans from this week without raising their prices. Current subscribers get it once their eligibility is confirmed.
details: Disney+ and Hulu shows are watched in their own apps, while live channels and Fubo's on-demand titles stay in the Fubo app. ESPN Unlimited carries on for eligible subscribers. Both plans keep unlimited cloud DVR and streaming on several devices at once; Elite adds 4K where available and extra channel packs. The report doesn't say how new subscribers or other Fubo plans get the bundle.
where: US, Fubo Pro and Elite subscribers, starting this week
means: If you're on Fubo Pro or Elite and also pay for Disney+ or Hulu with ads, you may be paying twice for the same shows.
todo: Watch for Fubo's message that your account is eligible, then sign in to the Disney+ and Hulu apps. Before cancelling a separate Disney+ or Hulu plan, check that the access is active and that you don't need the ad-free tier.
